intro: Anyone can read. With an account you can write, support and vote.
haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
checkMailText: We sent an email to {email}. Click the link in it to confirm your account.
verifyText: Later you will confirm once with your German ID card that you are a real person with only one account. During the test phase, signing in counts as verified.

errors.passkey: Signing in with a passkey did not work.
